current_bottleneck: The seven proof parties can generate a valid zkPI and threshold DvP package, but the prior canonical path discarded it and locally generated a different package from opened order and balance witnesses.
causal_hypothesis: If DeFMI pins the proof committee key and reservation commitments before matching, it can verify the collaborative package against the signed matching output and apply its commitments directly to canonical accounts without any local witness or replacement proof.
single_intended_change: Store the participant-edge reserve commitment in canonical reservation state, pin the collaborative FROST key at genesis, re-verify the complete collaborative package during canonical preparation, update account commitments from that package, and assert exact zkPI, nullifier, and package-digest identity after Avalanche acceptance.

baseline.limitation: The collaborative package was independently verified but not used as the canonical account-transition input.

most_likely_prediction_error: The MPC proof is defined over order-reservation commitments while canonical accounts hold full-balance commitments, so a verifier that incorrectly treats those as the same pre-state will reject or apply the wrong remainder.
